rows.en: On this planet there is a culture of protecting and passing things down. Protect, pass on, and make something new.
Once you destroy something, you can never make the same thing again.
On this planet, I learned the sorrow of destruction.
The teaching of the Mardook is to destroy everything, and they're trying to shut themselves inside that teaching.
rows.notes: Heard "Maruryuuku"; read as Mardook, as in ish_604.

rows.en: There's nothing to gain from destruction, and nothing can be created either.
We must not fight. We can understand each other.
On this Earth there are true songs.
Songs for happy times, songs for sad times, and love songs.
Even so, I believe it. That this is the ship of Ars.
As an Emulator, I want to tell all the Mardook the heart that Macross taught me.
I'll sing from my heart. The song of Ars.
